P.name: 6-Plex Avonmore
P.note: Siding, windows and doors are on and the entry steps are poured. Inside, the suites are at rough-in — ducting, plumbing and insulation going in ahead of drywall.
media: Dark siding and white panel, windows and doors in, steps poured.
Ducting, plumbing and insulation through the lower suite.
Insulation and vapour barrier going on ahead of drywall.

P.name: 8-Plex Sherwood Park
P.note: Cladding, windows and garage doors are on. Interiors are being finished suite by suite while the walkways are formed at the curb.
media: Siding, windows and garage doors installed; walkway forms at the curb.
Cabinets hung, flooring down, drywall painted.
Drywall finished and flooring laid through the main level.
A bank of separate meters on the side elevation.
Rebar tied and formed, ready to pour.
Batt insulation in the floor system before the ceiling closes up.

P.name: 8-Plex Prince Charles
P.note: Infill on a mature street off 118 Avenue. The main floor is framed and sheathed on the poured foundation, with windows going in above.
media: Main floor framed and braced on the poured foundation; sheathing and windows going in above.

P.name: 8-Plex Allendale
P.note: Two storeys framed and sheathed with windows in. A boom truck was on site setting the roof load the day these were taken.
media: Boom truck lifting trusses onto the second floor; both storeys framed, sheathed and glazed.
The load in the air over the rear of the building.
Street elevation with the site hoarding still up.

P.name: 8-Plex Glenwood
P.note: Drywall is finished and painted, bath surrounds are tiled and doors are hung. The framing shots at the end of the sequence are the same building last winter.
media: Painted and trimmed, window in, subfloor down.
Full-height marble-look tile around the tub.
Same finish level through the upper suites.
Interior doors hung and shelving in.
Boarded and taped ahead of paint.
Walls standing on the foundation with snow still on the ground.
Looking through the studs before sheathing closed it in.

P.name: 8-Plex Hazeldean
P.note: Siding and stucco are on, windows and doors in, and the entry decks are framed. The earlier shots in the sequence are the same building in spring, still wrapped.
media: Me out front on a walkthrough — this is the front elevation from the street.
Dark siding and cream stucco on, windows and doors in, entry decks framed.
Corner elevation with windows installed and the building wrap going up over the sheathing.

P.name: 9-Plex Inglewood
P.note: Nine doors rather than eight. The first block is closed in with siding and trim on, while the excavator was still working the servicing trench alongside it.
media: Siding, black trim and gable ends complete on the first block.
Excavator alongside the building with the water service run in.
Foundation forms and insulation going in through the snow.

P.name: 7-Plex Strathearn
P.note: Directly opposite the Strathearn LRT stop — tenants walk out the door and onto the platform. Framed, sheathed and glazed with the building wrap going on.
media: Windows in and building wrap going up over the sheathing.
Walking from the platform to the building — the stop is directly across the road.

P.name: 9-Plex Jasper Park
P.note: Filmed rather than photographed — two clips walking the site from the street through to the garden suite at the rear of the lot.
media: The front of the building from the street.
Walking the lot from the street through to the garden suite at the rear.

TIMELINE: The existing house comes down and the lot is cleared once the deal is firm.
Dig, footings, walls poured, then services run to the building.
Main and upper floors stood and braced on the foundation.
Trusses set, sheathing on, windows in, building wrapped.
Siding and trim outside; mechanical, electrical and insulation inside.
Board, tape and paint, then interior doors hung.
Kitchens, bath tile, flooring and fixtures land suite by suite.
Walkways formed and poured, parking and landscaping complete.
Units advertised and leased ahead of closing, then keys.
